verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that tasks created from Slack, Linear, or Jira have updates that 'sync both ways' (docs-26), and that ticket state is managed automatically (docs-9, docs-16). This implies status changes may surface in tools where a developer would see them, but no notification feature is ever explicitly described. missing for 10: explicit notifications on agent task completion, alerts when an agent is blocked or needs input, notification channel or configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
